selectionPolicy.winQualificationRule: Three supported core factors including current form and course/going/trip, one support factor and independently sourced review. Moderate downsides accepted; critical unknowns excluded. Odds not used for race confidence.

longshotsPolicy.priceRule: Prior reference prices only; recheck the live market.
